meta.description.en: Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.6-27B are dense hybrid Mamba-Transformer language models in the Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6 family, integrating breakthroughs in architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility. They share the same hybrid attention design (GDN + full attention) and the same deployment pattern on Ascend NPUs, suitable for general-purpose text generation tasks such as dialogue, content creation, and code generation.
meta.description.zh: Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.6-27B 是 Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6 系列的稠密混合 Mamba-Transformer 语言模型，在架构效率、强化学习规模和全球可访问性方面均有突破。两者共享相同的混合注意力设计（GDN + 全注意力）和 MTP 头设计，在昇腾 NPU 上的部署方式一致，适用于对话、内容创作、代码生成等通用文本生成任务。

meta.performance_headline.en: Single-node deployment on Atlas 800 A2/A3 with TP=2 + DP=8 DP-first parallelism
meta.performance_headline.zh: Atlas 800 A2/A3 单节点部署，采用 TP=2 + DP=8 的 DP-first 并行策略

overview.en: Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.6-27B are dense hybrid Mamba-Transformer language models in the Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6 family. Both share the same hybrid attention design (GDN + full attention) and the same MTP head design. They are suitable for general-purpose text generation tasks such as dialogue, content creation, and code generation.
overview.zh: Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.6-27B 是 Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6 系列的稠密混合 Mamba-Transformer 语言模型。两者共享相同的混合注意力设计（GDN + 全注意力）和 MTP 头设计，适用于对话、内容创作、代码生成等通用文本生成任务。

quantization.content.en:
Both models ship with pre-quantized W8A8 versions (with MTP speculative-decoding heads) published under the `Eco-Tech/` namespace on ModelScope. Quantized versions must be started with `--quantization ascend`. To disable quantization, remove the flag.

BF16 versions (under `Qwen/`) do not require the `--quantization ascend` flag.
quantization.content.zh:
两个模型均提供预量化的 W8A8 版本（带 MTP 投机解码头），发布于 ModelScope 的 `Eco-Tech/` 命名空间下。W8A8 版本启动时**必须**带 `--quantization ascend`，关闭量化请移除该参数。

BF16 版本（位于 `Qwen/` 命名空间下）无需 `--quantization ascend`。

prerequisites[0].content.en:
- **Atlas 800 A3** (64G × 16): 1 node minimum for single-node; 2 nodes for multi-node PD separation.
- **Atlas 800 A2** (64G × 8): 1 node minimum; multi-node PD separation not supported on this platform.
- **Atlas 300I DUO** (A2 300I inference etc.): at least 2 devices; only TP mode supported (TP=2 or TP=4).
prerequisites[0].content.zh:
- **Atlas 800 A3** (64G × 16)：单节点部署至少 1 个节点；多节点 PD 分离至少 2 个节点。
- **Atlas 800 A2** (64G × 8)：单节点部署至少 1 个节点；该平台不支持多节点 PD 分离。
- **Atlas 300I DUO**（A2 300I 推理等）：至少 2 个设备；仅支持 TP 模式（TP=2 或 TP=4）。

env_setup.pip.content.en:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend.git
cd vllm-ascend
pip install -e .
```

Verify:
```bash
pip show vllm-ascend
```

> **On Atlas 300I DUO**, you may need to uninstall `triton-ascend` and `triton` to avoid dependency conflicts.

```bash
pip uninstall -y triton-ascend triton
```

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
Single-node deployment of `Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp` on Atlas 800 A2 (TP=2). Same pattern applies to `Qwen3.6-27B-w8a8` — replace the model id and `--served-model-name`.

```bash
#!/bin/sh
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1

vllm serve your_model_path \
--host 0.0.0.0 \
--port 8000 \
--data-parallel-size 1 \
--tensor-parallel-size 2 \
--seed 1024 \
--quantization ascend \
--served-model-name qwen3.5 \
--max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
--max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
--max-num-batched-tokens 8096 \
--trust-remote-code \
--gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
{{prefix_caching}} \
{{spec_decoding}} \
{{compilation_config}} \
{{cpu_binding}} \
{{async_scheduling}}
```

For Qwen3.6-27B-w8a8: replace the model id with `Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-27B-w8a8`, `--served-model-name qwen3.6`, and raise `--max-model-len 262144` if needed.

scenarios[3].case.zh: 1P1D（1 个 Prefill 节点 + 1 个 Decode 节点）

scenarios[3].steps[0].content.en:
Use **2 Atlas 800 A3 (64G × 16)** nodes — one Prefill node, one Decode node. Each node runs `TP=2 + DP=8`, fully utilizing all 16 NPUs. Multi-node PD separation is **not supported on Atlas 300I DUO**.

> **Why TP=2 + DP=8 (DP-first)?** The model is only ~30 GB and fits in a single NPU. TP > 1 is only needed for models that don't fit in one NPU. Maximizing DP keeps all 16 NPUs busy with independent request batches — this is the standard pattern for small dense models.
scenarios[3].steps[0].content.zh:
使用 **2 台 Atlas 800 A3 (64G × 16)** —— 一台 Prefill 节点，一台 Decode 节点。每节点运行 `TP=2 + DP=8`，充分利用全部 16 个 NPU。Atlas 300I DUO**不支持**多节点 PD 分离。

> **为什么是 TP=2 + DP=8（DP-first）？** 模型仅 ~30 GB，单卡 64 GB HBM 即可放下。TP > 1 仅用于放不下的模型。最大化 DP 让 16 个 NPU 各自处理独立的请求 batch —— 这是小稠密模型的标准模式。

scenarios[3].steps[1].content.en:
Get the template from the repository examples: [run_dp_template.sh](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/external_online_dp/run_dp_template.sh).

```shell
nic_name="xxx"
local_ip="141.xx.xx.1"

export HCCL_IF_IP=$local_ip
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=$nic_name
export TP_SOCKET_IFNAME=$nic_name
export HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=$nic_name
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"

export OMP_PROC_BIND=false

export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/python/site-packages/mooncake:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
{{flashcomm1}}
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$1

vllm serve your_model_path \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port $2 \
  --data-parallel-size $3 \
  --data-parallel-rank $4 \
  --data-parallel-address $5 \
  --data-parallel-rpc-port $6 \
  --tensor-parallel-size $7 \
  --seed 1024 \
  --quantization ascend \
  --served-model-name qwen3.5 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --max-num-seqs 4 \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
  {{prefix_caching}} \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --enforce-eager \
  {{spec_decoding}} \
  {{cpu_binding}} \
  --kv-transfer-config \
  '{"kv_connector": "MooncakeConnectorV1",
  "kv_role": "kv_producer",
  "kv_port": "30000",
  "engine_id": "0",
```
```shell
  "kv_connector_extra_config": {
            "prefill": {"dp_size": 8, "tp_size": 2},
            "decode":  {"dp_size": 8, "tp_size": 2}
        }
      }'
```

scenarios[3].steps[3].title.en: Launch the DP engine on each node
scenarios[3].steps[3].title.zh: 在每节点启动 DP engine

scenarios[3].steps[3].content.en:
Get [launch_online_dp.py](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/external_online_dp/launch_online_dp.py) from the repository examples, then start the DP engines:

```shell
# p0 (Prefill node 0)
python launch_online_dp.py --dp-size 8 --tp-size 2 --dp-size-local 8 --dp-rank-start 0 \
  --dp-address 141.xx.xx.1 --dp-rpc-port 12321 --vllm-start-port 7100
# d0 (Decode node 0)
python launch_online_dp.py --dp-size 8 --tp-size 2 --dp-size-local 8 --dp-rank-start 0 \
  --dp-address 141.xx.xx.2 --dp-rpc-port 12321 --vllm-start-port 7100
```

```shell

  --host 141.xx.xx.1 \
  --prefiller-hosts 141.xx.xx.1 141.xx.xx.1 141.xx.xx.1 141.xx.xx.1 \
                    141.xx.xx.1 141.xx.xx.1 141.xx.xx.1 141.xx.xx.1 \
  --prefiller-ports  7100 7101 7102 7103 7104 7105 7106 7107 \
  --decoder-hosts    141.xx.xx.2 141.xx.xx.2 141.xx.xx.2 141.xx.xx.2 \
                      141.xx.xx.2 141.xx.xx.2 141.xx.xx.2 141.xx.xx.2 \
```

scenarios[4].steps[0].content.en:
Atlas 300I DUO single-node deployment. Currently only the **TP** scenario is supported — choose TP=2 or TP=4 according to the available devices.

```bash
#!/bin/sh
# Load model from ModelScope to speed up download
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True

# Model weight path; can be a ModelScope model id (e.g., Eco-Tech/Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp) or a local directory path
export MODEL_PATH=Eco-Tech/Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp

vllm serve $MODEL_PATH \
--host 127.0.0.1 \
--port 1025 \
--tensor-parallel-size 4 \
--served-model-name qwen3.5 \
--max-num-seqs 128 \
--max-model-len 16384 \
--trust-remote-code \
--gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16 \
--dtype float16 \
--speculative-config '{"method": "qwen3_5_mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}' \
{{compilation_config}} \
--additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"enable_npugraph_ex": false}}'
```

> - `--tensor-parallel-size`: choose TP=2 or TP=4 according to the available devices.
> - `--max-model-len 16384` is intentionally conservative on Atlas 300I DUO.
> - `--dtype float16` and `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16` match the Atlas inference execution path.
> - The quantized versions need to start with the `--quantization ascend` parameter.

### Using AISBench (recommended)

Refer to the vllm-ascend AISBench guide. After execution, AISBench prints the per-dataset accuracy. Example for `Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8` on `gsm8k`:

| dataset | version | metric | mode | vllm-api-general-chat |
|---------|---------|--------|------|-----------------------|
| gsm8k   | -       | accuracy | gen | 96.74 |

### Using Language Model Evaluation Harness (lm_eval)

Run `gsm8k` against the running server:

```shell
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3.5 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --quantization ascend \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --no-enable-prefix-caching

# Run lm_eval in another terminal
lm_eval \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=qwen3.5,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,tokenized_requests=False,trust_remote_code=True \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --output_path ./
```

tuning.en:
### Recommended configurations (validated; tune for your workload)

**Parallelism strategy**: `Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8` and `Qwen3.6-27B-w8a8` are ~30 GB and fit in a single 64 GB HBM NPU. Following the **DP-first** principle, **TP=2 is the recommended default** for most scenarios; remaining NPUs go to DP for parallel request batches. **TP=8 is only recommended for ultra-long context (256K+) scenarios** to shard KV cache across 8 NPUs.

**Atlas 300I DUO**: only TP is supported — choose **TP=2** or **TP=4**. With **TP=4**, `--max-model-len` can support **128K** and **256K** long-sequence scenarios.

| Scenario | Deployment | *NPUs | Weight | Notes |
|----------|------------|-------|--------|-------|
| High Throughput (128K ctx) | Single-Node (A2) | 8 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=2 + DP=4 — uses all 8 NPUs for parallel request batches |
| High Throughput (128K ctx) | Single-Node (A3) | 16 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=2 + DP=8 — uses all 16 NPUs for parallel request batches |
| Low Latency (128K ctx) | Single-Node (A3) | 16 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=2 + DP=8 — reduces per-layer Allreduce overhead for small interactive batches |
| Long Context (256K+ ctx) | Single-Node (A3) | 16 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=8 + DP=2 — shards KV cache across 8 NPUs to maximize context window |

*Total NPUs = 1 Atlas 800 A3 = 16 NPUs, 1 Atlas 800 A2 = 8 NPUs.

| Scenario | Config | TP | DP | Max Num Seqs | Max Num Batched Tokens | Max Model Len | MTP Num | Async Scheduling |
|----------|--------|----|----|--------------|------------------------|---------------|---------|-------------------|
| High Throughput (128K) | Single-Node A2 | 2 | 4 | 32 | 16384 | 133000 | 3 | On |
| High Throughput (128K) | Single-Node A3 | 2 | 8 | 32 | 16384 | 133000 | 3 | On |
| Low Latency (128K) | Single-Node A3 | 2 | 8 | 4 | 4096 | 133000 | 3 | On |
| Long Context (256K+) | Single-Node A3 | 8 | 2 | 8 | 8192 | 266000 | 3 | On |

### Tuning guidelines

Refer to the vllm-ascend performance tuning documentation and feature matrix for detailed feature descriptions. Key levers:
  - `--gpu-memory-utilization`: increase to allocate more KV cache; **risk of OOM** if too high (peak HBM during warm-up can exceed average)
  - `--max-num-batched-tokens`: larger = lower latency but higher HBM activation memory pressure
  - `--no-enable-prefix-caching`: required for hybrid Qwen3.5/3.6 KV cache (block_size grows to 2048; short prefixes are never cached)
  - `--speculative-config`: both Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 share the `qwen3_5_mtp` head; on Atlas 300I DUO set `num_speculative_tokens: 1`
  - `--compilation-config cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY`: recommended; PIECEWISE is the other option
  - On **PD separation**, enable `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1=1` and `recompute_scheduler_enable:true` on the decode node
tuning.zh:
### 推荐配置（已验证；请根据实际负载调优）

**并行策略**：`Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8` 和 `Qwen3.6-27B-w8a8` 约 30 GB，单卡 64 GB HBM 即可放下。按 **DP-first** 原则，**TP=2 是大多数场景的推荐默认值**；剩余 NPU 走 DP 处理并行请求 batch。**TP=8 仅推荐用于超长上下文（256K+）场景**，将 KV cache 分片到 8 个 NPU 以扩大上下文窗口。

**Atlas 300I DUO**：仅支持 TP —— 选择 **TP=2** 或 **TP=4**。**TP=4** 时 `--max-model-len` 可支持 **128K** 与 **256K** 长序列场景。

| 场景 | 部署 | *NPU 数 | 权重 | 说明 |
|----------|------------|-------|--------|-------|
| 高吞吐（128K 上下文） | 单节点（A2） | 8 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=2 + DP=4 —— 8 NPU 全部用于并行请求 batch |
| 高吞吐（128K 上下文） | 单节点（A3） | 16 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=2 + DP=8 —— 16 NPU 全部用于并行请求 batch |
| 低延迟（128K 上下文） | 单节点（A3） | 16 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=2 + DP=8 —— 减少小交互 batch 的逐层 Allreduce 开销 |
| 长上下文（256K+） | 单节点（A3） | 16 | Qwen3.x-27B-w8a8 | TP=8 + DP=2 —— KV cache 分片到 8 NPU，最大化上下文窗口 |

*总 NPU 数 = 1 台 Atlas 800 A3 = 16 NPU，1 台 Atlas 800 A2 = 8 NPU。

| 场景 | 配置 | TP | DP | Max Num Seqs | Max Num Batched Tokens | Max Model Len | MTP Num | Async Scheduling |
|----------|--------|----|----|--------------|------------------------|---------------|---------|-------------------|
| 高吞吐（128K） | 单节点 A2 | 2 | 4 | 32 | 16384 | 133000 | 3 | 开 |
| 高吞吐（128K） | 单节点 A3 | 2 | 8 | 32 | 16384 | 133000 | 3 | 开 |
| 低延迟（128K） | 单节点 A3 | 2 | 8 | 4 | 4096 | 133000 | 3 | 开 |
| 长上下文（256K+） | 单节点 A3 | 8 | 2 | 8 | 8192 | 266000 | 3 | 开 |

### 调优指南

详细特性说明参考 vllm-ascend 性能调优文档与 feature matrix。关键调优旋钮：
  - `--gpu-memory-utilization`：调高分配更多 KV cache；**过高有 OOM 风险**（warm-up 峰值 HBM 可能超过均值）
  - `--max-num-batched-tokens`：越大延迟越低，但 HBM 激活内存压力更大
  - `--no-enable-prefix-caching`：混合 Qwen3.5/3.6 KV cache 必须开启（block_size 会涨到 2048，短前缀不会被缓存）
  - `--speculative-config`：Qwen3.5 与 Qwen3.6 共用 `qwen3_5_mtp` 头；Atlas 300I DUO设 `num_speculative_tokens: 1`
  - `--compilation-config cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY`：推荐；PIECEWISE 是另一选项
  - 在 **PD 分离**上，开启 `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1=1`，decode 节点上开启 `recompute_scheduler_enable:true`
